title: Prospective and External Validation of Prognostic Machine Learning Models for Short- and Long-Term Mortality Among Acutely Admitted Patients Based on Blood Tests.
summary: Models using routine admission biomarkers predict short- and long-term mortality across three cohorts from two Danish hospitals; the preprint reports a specific clinical prediction result, not evidence of prospective impact on care.
ai_technology: Machine-learning prognostic models using routine admission biomarkers
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The preprint reports prediction of short- and long-term mortality from admission biomarkers across three cohorts drawn from two Danish hospitals.
